title: Elderflower Muffin Crostata
description: A unique Italian dessert featuring a crostata crust topped with elderflower-infused muffin mixture. The combination of textures and flavors creates a delightful experience.
instructions: Prepare the crostata crust by mixing together croatian biscotti crumbs and elderflower syrup or extract.
In a separate bowl, crumble the muffins into small pieces.
In a separate bowl, whip the bouncy until stiff peaks form.
Combine the crumbled muffins, whipped bouncy, and qq, mixing until just combined.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared crostata crust and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Allow the crostata to cool before serving.
